purpose: Conceptual editorial illustrations for five multilingual blog articles. These are not photographs of the measured equipment.

captions.en: AI-generated illustration based on the article's topic.
captions.ja: 記事のテーマを基にAIで生成したイメージです。

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished hero image for a serious multilingual engineering blog, one image from a coordinated five-part series about running an Edge0 local LLM and retrieval agent on an Apple Silicon laptop.
Primary request: Create a refined editorial 3D still-life illustration, tactile and understated, with believable manufactured shapes rather than a software screenshot or an explanatory diagram.
Scene/backdrop: a seamless deep graphite studio surface and background. Objects of brushed silver aluminum, matte charcoal ceramic, frosted glass, and pale ivory paper. Restrained cool blue reflected light, soft broad studio illumination and soft realistic shadows, crisp large silhouettes, subtle fine-grain material detail. Strong visual hierarchy readable as a small thumbnail.
Composition/framing: panoramic landscape, approximately 1.91:1 aspect ratio, ideally 1920 by 1008 pixels. Entire subject safely inside central 80 percent with breathing room on all sides. Balanced continuous composition, one scene, no panels, no borders, no blank title area.
Constraints: no text, letters, numerals, logos, watermarks, brand marks, chart labels, legible code, robot faces, brains, human figures or hands. Not a real product screenshot. Do not imply measured numbers or benchmark results. Avoid neon cyberpunk, dense glowing circuit networks, tiny scattered decorations, and excessive visual effects.
Subject for Part 1, local large-model inference on a memory-limited laptop: a beautifully proportioned thin open silver laptop with a dark reflective display, accompanied by a compact stack of charcoal storage slabs. A small carefully arranged cluster of frosted modular glass blocks hovers immediately above the keyboard, only a few blocks gently illuminated blue while the rest remain matte. Convey a large model accessed selectively from storage on a modest personal computer. The laptop is the dominant recognizable anchor; keep the symbolic block cluster restrained and physically coherent.

alt.ko: 은색 노트북 위의 유리 블록과 옆에 쌓인 저장 장치로 표현한 로컬 모델 추론
alt.en: Glass blocks above a silver laptop and stacked storage devices representing local model inference.
alt.ja: 銀色のノートPCの上に浮かぶガラスのブロックと積み重ねたストレージで表したローカルモデルの推論。
